name: dumbbell incline alternate hammer curl
description: Hammer curls on an incline bench, one arm at a time. The stretched position makes the biceps and brachialis work hard.
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench holding dumbbells with palms facing in.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl one dumbbell up without twisting your wrist.
Lower it slowly and repeat with the other arm.
